title: September Project Spotlight - Oasis Marrickville By Bayside Built
bodyHtml:
September's Project Spotlight features our exclusive hand painted limited edition basin series from our Collection Atelier - Ritual in Steel Cut

Oasis by Bayside Built is a gorgeous 3 bedroom home that combines state of the art smart home technology with carefully curated interior features - The result is a perfect marriage of form and function.

A heritage listed home with a beautiful traditional facade hides a brand new contemporary overhaul. Rustic and organic elements of reused brick, timber, steel and stone have come together to create a modern day sanctuary.

"Hand-made Morrocan concrete tiles do not only form a bold contrast to the clean wall tiling but also bring warmth and character to these often faceless environments.

Luxurious rain showerheads, underfloor heating and exclusive steel-cut bench basins ultimately turn them into a private spa. We designed timber veneer built-in joinery and floating vanities that offer space for washing appliances and necessities."

Completion: August 2020
Client: Private
Construction: Bayside Built
Photos by: Sebastian Photography
